evidence: Authored for this product: instruction.md:1 is a first-person ask specific to a code playground ('paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source'); the six notes describe product-specific rules that no sibling has - .js/.html filename chooses execution mode (overview.md:3), isolated preview with network and dynamic-evaluation refusal (security.md:3-5), five-second run budget, Stop, superseding runs and last-good picture restore (behaviour.md:5-7), token-category colouring and Format document with one-step undo (ui.md:13-15), live library refresh that preserves caret/scroll/undo (behaviour.md:11). task.toml:5-14 names, describes and tags the product consistently (arena_slice 'custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history'); app_context.md:3-14 describes the same single no-account workspace. All 38 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual and 3 gate criteria carry product-specific cw_ ids. Sibling comparison: the closest sibling by concept is projects/patchpad-editor(-v2/-v3) (custom editing surface, graphemes, multi-caret, find/replace, revisions, stale-save conflict). Roughly 16 of Colderwater's 38 functional criteria cover that shared editor/revision ground, but about 22 (colouring x2, format x3, html preview, error/rejection line x2, console x2, run budget x2, last-good, stop, supersede, isolation, dynamic-code refusal, live library x3) have no Patchpad counterpart, and Patchpad's seeded incident report, word navigation, direct-API rejection matrix and manifest criteria are absent here. Measured: 8-word shingle overlap between Colderwater's criteria text and every sibling's judge.toml after subtracting template boilerplate is 0 for all three Patchpad versions and at most 3 for any other sibling (dropline-four-connect, docketlight); overlap between Colderwater's brief/notes and any sibling brief/notes is 0. Residue grep of the frozen task for patchpad|gridforge|boardloom|pixeldeck|incident|workbook|northwind|CHANGE_ME|TODO|FIXME returned no hits. Broken-app probe: a Patchpad-style editor with no run/preview would fail the render gate (cw_authored_custom_editor_run requires Run output), so the task cannot be satisfied by a sibling's golden. Limitation: no written suite 'domain plan' document exists in the workspace beyond NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:203 ('author distinct domain behavior. Do not make nouns-swapped clones'); fit was judged against that rule and the sibling list, where this is the only code playground / devtools product. Conceptual overlap with Patchpad on the custom-editor core is real but is not a renamed-entities clone.
